1.web: I exhort the elders among you, as a fellow elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and who will also share in the glory that will be revealed.
1.asv: The elders therefore among you I exhort, who am a fellow-elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, who am also a partaker of the glory that shall be revealed:

2.web: Shepherd the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not under compulsion, but voluntarily, not for dishonest gain, but willingly;
2.asv: Tend the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not of constraint, but willingly, according to the will of God; nor yet for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind;

3.web: neither as lording it over those entrusted to you, but making yourselves examples to the flock.
3.asv: neither as lording it over the charge allotted to you, but making yourselves ensamples to the flock.

4.web: When the chief Shepherd is revealed, you will receive the crown of glory that doesn’t fade away.
4.asv: And when the chief Shepherd shall be manifested, ye shall receive the crown of glory that fadeth not away.

5.web: Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility, to subject yourselves to one another; for “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
5.asv: Likewise, ye younger, be subject unto the elder. Yea, all of you gird yourselves with humility, to serve one another: for God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace to the humble.

6.web: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time;
6.asv: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time;

7.web: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.
7.asv: casting all your anxiety upon him, because he careth for you.

8.web: Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful. Your adversary, the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.
8.asv: Be sober, be watchful: your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:

9.web: Withstand him steadfast in your faith, knowing that your brothers who are in the world are undergoing the same sufferings.
9.asv: whom withstand stedfast in your faith, knowing that the same sufferings are accomplished in your brethren who are in the world.

10.web: But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.
10.asv: And the God of all grace, who called you unto his eternal glory in Christ, after that ye have suffered a little while, shall himself perfect, establish, strengthen you.

11.web: To him be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.
11.asv: To him be the dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

12.web: Through Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I consider him, I have written to you briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God in which you stand.
12.asv: By Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I accounthim, I have written unto you briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God: stand ye fast therein.

13.web: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you; and so does Mark, my son.
13.asv: She that is in Babylon, elect together with you, saluteth you; and so doth Mark my son.

14.web: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace be to you all who are in Christ Jesus. Amen.
14.asv: Salute one another with a kiss of love. Peace be unto you all that are in Christ.
